summary.tldr: Amends the Constitution Act, 1867 so Quebec would have at least 25% of seats in the House of Commons after seat readjustment.
what_it_does: Adds a rule to section 51 of the Constitution Act, 1867 that requires extra Quebec seats if needed so Quebec has at least 25% of all House of Commons members after readjustment.
Keeps the total number of Quebec members from falling below one quarter of the House of Commons when seats are redistributed.
Gives the bill the short title Constitution Act, 2022 (representation of Quebec).
summary.background: The bill amends section 51 of the Constitution Act, 1867, which sets the rules for how House of Commons seats are readjusted.
